operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Locks or unlocks an entity record on behalf of an installed app.

Intended for third-party app integrations: an installed app can lock a specific record of any entity it has access to (preventing further edits) or unlock it again. Send `true` in the `lock` path segment to lock the record; any other value unlocks it.

Authenticated with an OAuth bearer token. The response is always HTTP `200` with a `{ status, msg }` object — inspect `status` to tell success from the two failure cases (the app is not installed/active for the site, or the record was not found).

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The installed app's id (the app performing the lock/unlock).

parameters.name: entityKey
parameters.description: The entity key of the record to lock/unlock (e.g. `product`, `invoice`).

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: The id of the record within the entity.

parameters.name: lock
parameters.description: Send `true` to lock the record; any other value unlocks it.

200.description:
Lock/unlock outcome. Example bodies:

Locked:
```json
{ "status": true, "msg": "Record locked successfully" }
```
Unlocked:
```json
{ "status": true, "msg": "Record unlocked successfully" }
```
App not installed/inactive (still HTTP 200):
```json
{ "status": false, "msg": "App is not installed or inactive" }
```
Record not found (still HTTP 200):
```json
{ "status": false, "msg": "Record not found" }
```

schema.description: The lock/unlock outcome. Always returned with HTTP `200` — inspect `status` to distinguish success from the two failure cases.

status.description: `true` when the record was locked/unlocked; `false` when the app is not installed/active for the site, or the record was not found.

msg.description:
Localized, human-readable outcome message.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Record locked successfully | The record is now locked. |
| Record unlocked successfully | The record is now unlocked. |
| App is not installed or inactive | The app is not installed or not active for the current site. |
| Record not found | No record matches the given entity/id. |

schema.description: Authentication failed or was missing (a valid OAuth bearer token is required).

message.description: Returned when no valid access token is supplied.
